---
name: Feature request
about: Something till should do and does not
labels: enhancement
---

## The problem

What are you trying to do, and what stops you? Not the feature — the situation.

## Have you read the scope note

[`docs/design/0005-scope.md`](../../docs/design/0005-scope.md) lists what is deliberately left out
and why. If this is on that list, the useful discussion is about the reason rather than the feature,
so please say which reason you think is wrong.

## What you would do instead today

Usually there is a way. Knowing what it costs you is the strongest argument for changing it.

## What it would cost

Best guess: a migration, a wire format change, a new dependency, a new operational concern?
